description: This file is a script that analyzes TypeScript source code to identify deprecated HTTP handler registration calls, specifically looking for 'registerHttpHandler' property accesses. It utilizes the TypeScript compiler API to parse and inspect the source code, and includes utility functions for processing call expressions and running the analysis as a script.

methods.name: isDeprecatedRegisterHttpHandlerCall
methods.description: Determines if a given expression is a property access expression calling 'registerHttpHandler', indicating a deprecated API usage.

methods.name: findDeprecatedRegisterHttpHandlerLines
methods.description: Parses source content to find all lines where the deprecated 'registerHttpHandler' is called.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Runs the guard analysis to identify deprecated register HTTP handler calls and outputs relevant messages.
